程序包 org.bukkit.inventory

接口 InventoryView

所有已知子接口:
AnvilView, BeaconView, BrewingStandView, CrafterView, EnchantmentView, FurnaceView, LecternView, LoomView, MerchantView, StonecutterView
public interface InventoryView
代表连接两个物品栏(从UI上理解即为上下各一个)与单个玩家 (其物品栏可能也可能不是视图代表的两个物品栏之一)的背包视图.

原文： Represents a view linking two inventories and a single player (whose inventory may or may not be one of the two).

      @NotNull @NotNull InventoryType getType()
      判断该事件中物品栏的类型. 这表示将被展示的窗口样式. 该方法永不会返回PLAYER值.

    • setItem

      void setItem(int slot, @Nullable @Nullable ItemStack item)
      设置该物品栏指定槽位的物品.

      注意: 如果id是 -999, 那么该物品将被扔在地面上. 然而, 这不是必须的行为. (所以你还是通过常规方法扔物品, 毕竟写个-999不看文档的人谁看得懂呢...233).

      原文： Sets one item in this inventory view by its raw slot ID.

      Note: If slot ID -999 is chosen, it may be expected that the item is dropped on the ground. This is not required behaviour, however.

      参数:
      slot - 槽位id (可以通过InventoryClickEvent.getRawSlot()获取)

      原文：The ID as returned by InventoryClickEvent.getRawSlot()

      item - 要放置的物品, null则清除

      原文：The new item to put in the slot, or null to clear it.

    • getItem

    • getInventory

      @Nullable @Nullable Inventory getInventory(int rawSlot)
      获取与给定原始槽位 ID 对应的物品栏. 如果槽位 ID 是 OUTSIDE 则返回 null, 否则对于非法和负数槽位 ID 的行为是未定义的. 可与 convertSlot(int) 一起使用来直接索引底层物品栏.

      原文： Gets the inventory corresponding to the given raw slot ID. If the slot ID is OUTSIDE null will be returned, otherwise behaviour for illegal and negative slot IDs is undefined. May be used with convertSlot(int) to directly index an underlying inventory.

      参数:
      rawSlot - 原始槽位 ID

      原文：The raw slot ID.

      返回:
      对应的物品栏, 或 null

      原文：corresponding inventory, or null

    • convertSlot

      int convertSlot(int rawSlot)
      将原始槽位id转换为本地槽位id (本地槽位id适用于当前正在查看的两个物品栏).

      若原始槽位id指向窗口的上半部分的物品栏, 那么返回的值不变, 此时返回值适用于getTopInventory().getItem(); 若该id指向底部物品栏, 返回的值将与原始槽位id不同, 此时返回值适用于getBottomInventory().getItem().

      这是玩家背包的一个实例(来自代码注释):

      原文： Converts a raw slot ID into its local slot ID into whichever of the two inventories the slot points to.

      If the raw slot refers to the upper inventory, it will be returned unchanged and thus be suitable for getTopInventory().getItem(); if it refers to the lower inventory, the output will differ from the input and be suitable for getBottomInventory().getItem().

      参数:
      rawSlot - 原始槽位id

      原文：The raw slot ID.

      返回:
      转换后的槽位id

      原文：The converted slot ID.

    • getSlotType

      @NotNull InventoryType.SlotType getSlotType(int slot)
      根据原始槽位 ID 确定槽位的类型.

      如果槽位类型未知, 则返回 InventoryType.SlotType.CONTAINER.

      原文： Determine the type of the slot by its raw slot ID.

      If the type of the slot is unknown, then InventoryType.SlotType.CONTAINER will be returned.

      参数:
      slot - 原始槽位 ID

      原文：The raw slot ID

      返回:
      槽位类型

      原文：the slot type

    • close

      void close()
      关闭该窗口视图.

      原文： Closes the inventory view.

    • countSlots

      int countSlots()
      检查此视图中的总槽位数, 合并上方和下方物品栏.

      注意, 如果某些槽位未被使用, 此值可能大于两个物品栏的总和.

      原文： Check the total number of slots in this view, combining the upper and lower inventories.

      Note though that it's possible for this to be greater than the sum of the two inventories if for example some slots are not being used.

      返回:
      总大小

      原文：The total size

    • setProperty

      boolean setProperty(@NotNull @NotNull InventoryView.Property prop, int value)
      设置此物品栏的额外属性 (如果该物品栏支持), 例如进度条的状态.

      原文： Sets an extra property of this inventory if supported by that inventory, for example the state of a progress bar.

      参数:
      prop - 要更新的窗口属性

      原文：the window property to update

      value - 窗口属性的新值

      原文：the new value for the window property

      返回:
      如果属性更新成功则返回 true, 如果该物品栏不支持该属性则返回 false

      原文：true if the property was updated successfully, false if the property is not supported by that inventory

    • setTitle

      @Deprecated(since="1.21.1") void setTitle(@NotNull @NotNull java.lang.String title)
      已过时。
      changing the title is not supported. This method has poorly defined and broken behaviors. It should not be used.
      设置此物品栏窗口的标题 (如果物品栏窗口支持).

      注意, 如果物品栏不支持可更改的标题 (即不是可创建的或由玩家查看的), 则此方法将抛出异常.

      原文： Sets the title of this inventory window to the specified title if the inventory window supports it.

      Note if the inventory does not support titles that can be changed (ie, it is not creatable or viewed by a player), then this method will throw an exception.

      参数:
      title - 新标题

      原文：The new title.

    • getMenuType

      @Experimental @Nullable @Nullable MenuType getMenuType()
      Gets the menu type of the inventory view if applicable.

      Some inventory types do not support a menu type. In such cases, this method returns null. This typically applies to inventories belonging to entities like players or animals (e.g., a horse).

      返回:
      the menu type of the inventory view or null if not applicable
